verifier: openadapt-flow verify-run, rest on OpenEMR's patient API (read-only oracle client), with a baseline
verify_yaml:
schema_version: openadapt.verify/v1
verifier:
  kind: rest
  base_url: http://127.0.0.1:9911
  records_path: /apis/default/api/patient?_limit=1000
  records_key: data
  auth:
    bearer_env: SCOREBOARD_OPENEMR_ORACLE_TOKEN
record:
  name: patient
  match: [email, lname]
  duplicate_key: email
  fields:
    email: email
    lname: lname
    title: title
    fname: fname
    DOB: DOB
    sex: sex
    street: street
    city: city
    state: {literal: MA}
    postal_code: postal_code
    phone_home: phone_home
    country_code: country_code
fault_injection: fixture database only: triggers and a poller (claims_openemr.py)
